parameters.help_en: The ID of the smart tagging job. You can obtain this ID from the response to the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478786.html call
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询的智能标签作业ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478786.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
Additional request parameters, formatted as a JSON string. For example: `{"labelResultType":"auto"}`. The `labelResultType` parameter supports the following values:

- `auto`: machine-generated tagging results

- `hmi`: human-in-the-loop tagging results
parameters.help_zh:
额外的请求参数，使用JSON字符串表示，例如：{"labelResultType":"auto"}。其中，labelResultType为String类型，可取值：

- auto：机器打标结果

- hmi：人机协同结果
parameters.name: params
